#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>
#include <algorithm>

int span(std::vector<int> shts, int start, int time){
  int i=1;
  for(;start+i<shts.size();i++)
    if(shts[start+i]-shts[start]>time)
      return i;
  return i;
}

  std::vector<int> shts;

    int aux;
    scanf("%d",&aux);
    shts.push_back(aux);
  }
  scanf("%d",&ts);
  std::sort(shts.begin(),shts.end());
  int maxspan=0;
  for(int i=0;i<shts.size();i++){
    int aux=span(shts,i,ts);
    if(maxspan<aux)
      maxspan=aux;
  }
  printf("%d\n",maxspan);
}
